about_the_game:
Play as Claude Van Claude: imprisoned for 14 years for stealing a loaf of bread, just released and on a desperate quest to find his daughter before she's caught in a violent revolution gripping the streets of Paris. Meanwhile, Inspector LaBleugh is in chase, threatening to send Claude back to jail unless he can finally pull off a daring escape…Featuring:

๏ Hand drawn art for your eyes!

๏ Live voice performance for your ears!

๏ Mysteries and puzzles for your brain!

๏ Star-crossed lovers for your heart!

๏ Parisian sewers for your nose!

Solve the mystery of what happened to your daughter while you were incarcerated, by solving puzzles for the four people that helped her, and uncovering her story. Can you find her new occupation and location, before she is caught up in another bloody revolution?

Helped by lively period characters, including eccentric blacksmiths, paranoid bakers, Alexandre Dumas and Hector Berlioz, you'll help revolutionaries with suspiciously long baguettes, break into Notre Dame, and ride a horseless horse. Plus:

  • Take part in Dickensian child-labour!

  • Deface famous monuments!

  • Incite revolutionary riots!

  • Empty chairs and tables!

  • Dress as a sheep!

  • Hear people sing!

Part 'Monkey Island', part 'Allo 'Allo, Less Miserables aims to do for 'Les Misérables' what 'Life of Brian' did to The Bible. Vive la révolution! With more than 4 hours of comedy-puzzle adventures, and more than 30 locations across revolutionary France, wishlist Less Miserables, and join the revolution today!
